We compare two systems for interactive visualization design. The first combines an adaptive selection controller with a fixed view renderer; the second keeps both components fixed. To avoid ambiguity, this section calls them the adaptive system and the fixed system. A third configuration, introduced only in the final ablation, disables the selection controller entirely. It is not the same as the fixed system. All three configurations receive identical visual marks, but only the first two are included in the main comparison. References to "both systems" below therefore exclude the third configuration.

The primary endpoint is task completion time. The secondary endpoint is error rate. These endpoints are reported separately because improving one need not improve the other. We define an improvement relative to the fixed system under the same workload and measurement procedure. A result obtained under a different workload is described as a separate experiment, even if its numerical value happens to be better. The primary table contains five independently initialized runs for each system. Repeated observations within a run are used to estimate that run's endpoint; they are not counted as additional independent runs.

The development workload contains first-time participants, whereas the stress workload includes experienced participants. The stress workload is constructed before inspecting the final outputs. It remains unchanged throughout the comparison. Neither system may use the stress outputs to select a checkpoint or adjust a threshold. When the adaptive system updates its internal state during inference, those updates are part of the evaluated method. They do not authorize an experimenter to alter the externally specified threshold after seeing a failure. This distinction matters because otherwise adaptation and retrospective tuning would be indistinguishable.

At the start of each run, both systems have empty application caches. The selection controller may nevertheless reuse immutable preprocessing shared by all configurations. We measure this preprocessing separately and disclose it in the report. The first timed request begins only after preprocessing has finished. A second table includes the preprocessing cost, allowing readers to assess a one-shot use case. These two tables answer different questions. Their numbers must not be added together, because the second already includes the work described by the first. A cache hit inside the timed region is recorded explicitly.

The adaptive system performs better on the development workload in four of the five runs. In the remaining run, the difference is smaller than the measurement resolution. This observation does not establish that the adaptive system is universally superior. On the stress workload, it fails on two inputs that the fixed system handles successfully. Conversely, the fixed system fails on three inputs that the adaptive system handles successfully. We retain every failure in the denominator when reporting completion rates. Quality among completed outputs is also reported, but it is labeled as a conditional statistic.

We compare two systems for interactive visualization design. The first combines an adaptive selection controller with a fixed view renderer; the second keeps both components fixed. To avoid ambiguity, this section calls them the adaptive system and the fixed system. A third configuration, introduced only in the final ablation, disables the selection controller entirely. It is not the same as the fixed system. All three configurations receive identical visual marks, but only the first two are included in the main comparison. References to "both systems" below therefore exclude the third configuration.

The primary endpoint is task completion time. The secondary endpoint is error rate. These endpoints are reported separately because improving one need not improve the other. We define an improvement relative to the fixed system under the same workload and measurement procedure. A result obtained under a different workload is described as a separate experiment, even if its numerical value happens to be better. The primary table contains five independently initialized runs for each system. Repeated observations within a run are used to estimate that run's endpoint; they are not counted as additional independent runs.

The development workload contains first-time participants, whereas the stress workload includes experienced participants. The stress workload is constructed before inspecting the final outputs. It remains unchanged throughout the comparison. Neither system may use the stress outputs to select a checkpoint or adjust a threshold. When the adaptive system updates its internal state during inference, those updates are part of the evaluated method. They do not authorize an experimenter to alter the externally specified threshold after seeing a failure. This distinction matters because otherwise adaptation and retrospective tuning would be indistinguishable.

At the start of each run, both systems have empty application caches. The selection controller may nevertheless reuse immutable preprocessing shared by all configurations. We measure this preprocessing separately and disclose it in the report. The first timed request begins only after preprocessing has finished. A second table includes the preprocessing cost, allowing readers to assess a one-shot use case. These two tables answer different questions. Their numbers must not be added together, because the second already includes the work described by the first. A cache hit inside the timed region is recorded explicitly.

The adaptive system performs better on the development workload in four of the five runs. In the remaining run, the difference is smaller than the measurement resolution. This observation does not establish that the adaptive system is universally superior. On the stress workload, it fails on two inputs that the fixed system handles successfully. Conversely, the fixed system fails on three inputs that the adaptive system handles successfully. We retain every failure in the denominator when reporting completion rates. Quality among completed outputs is also reported, but it is labeled as a conditional statistic.

Inspection of the failed cases suggests an important limitation: a participant may finish quickly while misunderstanding the represented uncertainty. The inspection identifies a plausible mechanism, not a proven causal explanation. To test that mechanism, a follow-up experiment would need to vary the suspected factor while holding other factors constant. The present comparison does not do that. Its evidence supports a narrower statement: the observed failures are consistent with the proposed mechanism. Translating this statement as a demonstration of causality would materially strengthen the claim beyond the evidence supplied by the experiment.

It helps determine whether that component contributes to the observed behavior, but it is not used to replace either main system in the headline comparison. The diagnostic subset is deliberately enriched for difficult cases and does not estimate their frequency in ordinary use. We therefore publish its results separately. The released configuration, dataset identifiers, and individual run records make the comparison reproducible; they do not guarantee that a different machine or workload will reproduce the same absolute timings.

Protocol for evaluating streaming quantile estimation:

1. Prepare the stream items. Record the configuration identifier and the order of the inputs before either system runs. Retain the original ordering in the archive, even when a randomized execution order is used during measurement.

2. Initialize the compactor. If initialization fails, record an initialization failure and stop that run. Do not count the failure as a completed output from the query estimator. The next run starts from a fresh state and receives its own identifier.

3. Measure rank error. Include unsuccessful inputs in the completion-rate denominator. Compute the quality statistic only where a corresponding output exists, and label that statistic as conditional on completion. These two denominators are intentionally different.

4. Measure memory usage in a separate field. A missing observation is recorded as unknown, rather than as zero. Zero is a valid measured value and cannot also stand for missing information without making the record ambiguous.

5. Inspect the limitation that a probabilistic rank guarantee is not a guarantee on the numerical distance between values. Attach the source input, the observed output, and the smallest relevant configuration to the failure record. The explanation should identify what the evidence supports and what remains speculative.

Acceptance condition: every scheduled input has exactly one terminal record, all configuration identifiers are recoverable, and no missing observation is silently replaced. Passing this condition establishes that the experiment was recorded consistently. It does not establish that the evaluated method is correct on every possible input. The original inputs remain available for a later rerun.

source:
The implementation of multi-view scene reconstruction exposes two operations, `prepare_item(x)` and `accept_item(x)`. These names are identifiers, so changing their spelling would change the example. The first operation invokes the camera estimator; the second makes the prepared result visible to the renderer. A successful preparation is necessary but not sufficient for acceptance. The following expression is the complete acceptance condition: `prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`. The expression uses conjunction, not disjunction. If any of its three terms is false, the result is discarded without updating the visible state.

A worker may finish preparation after the user has changed the configuration. Such a worker still carries the old epoch. Its result must be rejected even when the underlying computation succeeded, because it no longer answers the current request. This rejection is a control-flow decision and must not be reported as a numerical failure of the method. By contrast, a result produced under the current epoch can still fail validation if it violates the stated invariant.

The test creates one slow worker and one fast worker. The slow worker starts first, but the fast worker completes first after a configuration change. The visible result must come from the fast worker. The test then releases the slow worker and checks that the visible result remains unchanged. It also checks that `accepted_count` increases exactly once and that `discarded_count` increases exactly once. Neither counter measures the number of input images.
translation:
多视图场景重建的实现暴露了两个操作，`prepare_item(x)` 和 `accept_item(x)`。这些名称是标识符，因此改变它们的拼写会改变该示例。第一个操作调用相机估计器；第二个操作使准备好的结果对渲染器可见。成功的准备是接受（acceptance）的必要条件，但不是充分条件。以下表达式是完整的接受条件：`prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`。该表达式使用的是合取（conjunction），而非析取（disjunction）。如果它的三个项中有任何一个为假，结果将被丢弃，而不会更新可见状态。

工作线程可能在用户更改配置之后才完成准备。这样的工作线程仍然携带旧的 epoch。即使其底层计算成功了，它的结果也必须被拒绝，因为它不再回答当前的请求。这种拒绝是一个控制流决策，绝不能被报告为该方法的数值失败。相比之下，在当前 epoch 下产生的结果如果违反了所述的不变量，仍然可能未通过验证。

该测试创建一个慢工作线程和一个快工作线程。慢工作线程先启动，但快工作线程在配置更改后先完成。可见结果必须来自快工作线程。随后测试释放慢工作线程，并检查可见结果保持不变。测试还检查 `accepted_count` 恰好增加一次，并且 `discarded_count` 恰好增加一次。这两个计数器都不衡量输入图像的数量。

source:
We compare two systems for interactive visualization design. The first combines an adaptive selection controller with a fixed view renderer; the second keeps both components fixed. To avoid ambiguity, this section calls them the adaptive system and the fixed system. A third configuration, introduced only in the final ablation, disables the selection controller entirely. It is not the same as the fixed system. All three configurations receive identical visual marks, but only the first two are included in the main comparison. References to "both systems" below therefore exclude the third configuration.

The primary endpoint is task completion time. The secondary endpoint is error rate. These endpoints are reported separately because improving one need not improve the other. We define an improvement relative to the fixed system under the same workload and measurement procedure. A result obtained under a different workload is described as a separate experiment, even if its numerical value happens to be better. The primary table contains five independently initialized runs for each system. Repeated observations within a run are used to estimate that run's endpoint; they are not counted as additional independent runs.

The development workload contains first-time participants, whereas the stress workload includes experienced participants. The stress workload is constructed before inspecting the final outputs. It remains unchanged throughout the comparison. Neither system may use the stress outputs to select a checkpoint or adjust a threshold. When the adaptive system updates its internal state during inference, those updates are part of the evaluated method. They do not authorize an experimenter to alter the externally specified threshold after seeing a failure. This distinction matters because otherwise adaptation and retrospective tuning would be indistinguishable.

At the start of each run, both systems have empty application caches. The selection controller may nevertheless reuse immutable preprocessing shared by all configurations. We measure this preprocessing separately and disclose it in the report. The first timed request begins only after preprocessing has finished. A second table includes the preprocessing cost, allowing readers to assess a one-shot use case. These two tables answer different questions. Their numbers must not be added together, because the second already includes the work described by the first. A cache hit inside the timed region is recorded explicitly.

The adaptive system performs better on the development workload in four of the five runs. In the remaining run, the difference is smaller than the measurement resolution. This observation does not establish that the adaptive system is universally superior. On the stress workload, it fails on two inputs that the fixed system handles successfully. Conversely, the fixed system fails on three inputs that the adaptive system handles successfully. We retain every failure in the denominator when reporting completion rates. Quality among completed outputs is also reported, but it is labeled as a conditional statistic.

Inspection of the failed cases suggests an important limitation: a participant may finish quickly while misunderstanding the represented uncertainty. The inspection identifies a plausible mechanism, not a proven causal explanation. To test that mechanism, a follow-up experiment would need to vary the suspected factor while holding other factors constant. The present comparison does not do that. Its evidence supports a narrower statement: the observed failures are consistent with the proposed mechanism. Translating this statement as a demonstration of causality would materially strengthen the claim beyond the evidence supplied by the experiment.

Finally, the ablation without the selection controller is evaluated on a small diagnostic subset. It helps determine whether that component contributes to the observed behavior, but it is not used to replace either main system in the headline comparison. The diagnostic subset is deliberately enriched for difficult cases and does not estimate their frequency in ordinary use. We therefore publish its results separately. The released configuration, dataset identifiers, and individual run records make the comparison reproducible; they do not guarantee that a different machine or workload will reproduce the same absolute timings.
translation:
我们比较两种交互式可视化设计系统。第一种将自适应选择控制器与固定视图渲染器相结合；第二种则保持两个组件均固定。为避免歧义，本节将它们分别称为自适应系统和固定系统。第三种配置仅在最后的消融实验中引入，它完全禁用选择控制器。它与固定系统并不相同。这三种配置接收完全相同的视觉标记，但只有前两种被纳入主比较。因此，下文提到的“两种系统”均不包含第三种配置。

主要终点是任务完成时间。次要终点是错误率。这两个终点分别报告，因为改善其中一个并不必然改善另一个。我们将改进定义为在相同工作负载和测量流程下相对于固定系统的改进。在不同工作负载下获得的结果被描述为单独的实验，即使其数值恰好更好。主表中每个系统包含五个独立初始化的运行。一次运行内的重复观测用于估计该运行的终点；它们不计为额外的独立运行。

开发工作负载包含首次参与的参与者，而压力工作负载则包含有经验的参与者。压力工作负载在检查最终输出之前构建，并在整个比较过程中保持不变。任何系统都不得使用压力输出来选择检查点或调整阈值。当自适应系统在推理过程中更新其内部状态时，这些更新属于被评估方法的一部分。它们并不授权实验者在看到失败之后更改外部指定的阈值。这一区分很重要，否则自适应与回顾性调优将无法区分。

在每次运行开始时，两种系统的应用缓存均为空。尽管如此，选择控制器可以复用所有配置共享的不可变预处理。我们单独测量该预处理，并在报告中予以披露。第一次计时请求仅在预处理完成后才开始。第二张表包含预处理成本，使读者能够评估一次性使用的场景。这两张表回答的是不同的问题。它们的数字不得相加，因为第二张表已经包含了第一张表所描述的工作。计时区域内的缓存命中会被明确记录。

自适应系统在五次运行中的四次里于开发工作负载上表现更好。在其余一次运行中，差异小于测量分辨率。这一观察并不能证明自适应系统普遍更优。在压力工作负载上，它在两个输入上失败，而固定系统能够成功处理这两个输入。相反，固定系统在三个输入上失败，而自适应系统能够成功处理这三个输入。在报告完成率时，我们将每一次失败都保留在分母中。已完成输出的质量也会报告，但被标注为条件统计量。

对失败案例的检查揭示了一个重要局限：参与者可能在误解所呈现的不确定性的情况下快速完成任务。该检查识别出一种合理的机制，而非已证实的因果解释。要检验该机制，后续实验需要在保持其他因素不变的同时改变疑似因素。本次比较并未这样做。其证据支持一个更窄的陈述：观察到的失败与所提出的机制相一致。将这一陈述翻译为因果性的证明，将实质性地把该主张强化到超出实验所提供证据的程度。

最后，不含选择控制器的消融实验在一个小型诊断子集上进行评估。它有助于确定该组件是否对观察到的行为有贡献，但它不用于在头条比较中替代任何一个主系统。诊断子集被有意富集了困难案例，并不估计这些案例在普通使用中的频率。因此我们单独发布其结果。所发布的配置、数据集标识符以及单次运行记录使该比较可复现；它们并不保证不同的机器或工作负载会复现相同的绝对计时。

name: GLM-5.3 Flash · Chat · low
source:
Protocol for evaluating streaming quantile estimation:

1. Prepare the stream items. Record the configuration identifier and the order of the inputs before either system runs. Retain the original ordering in the archive, even when a randomized execution order is used during measurement.

2. Initialize the compactor. If initialization fails, record an initialization failure and stop that run. Do not count the failure as a completed output from the query estimator. The next run starts from a fresh state and receives its own identifier.

3. Measure rank error. Include unsuccessful inputs in the completion-rate denominator. Compute the quality statistic only where a corresponding output exists, and label that statistic as conditional on completion. These two denominators are intentionally different.

4. Measure memory usage in a separate field. A missing observation is recorded as unknown, rather than as zero. Zero is a valid measured value and cannot also stand for missing information without making the record ambiguous.

5. Inspect the limitation that a probabilistic rank guarantee is not a guarantee on the numerical distance between values. Attach the source input, the observed output, and the smallest relevant configuration to the failure record. The explanation should identify what the evidence supports and what remains speculative.

Acceptance condition: every scheduled input has exactly one terminal record, all configuration identifiers are recoverable, and no missing observation is silently replaced. Passing this condition establishes that the experiment was recorded consistently. It does not establish that the evaluated method is correct on every possible input. The original inputs remain available for a later rerun.
translation:
流式分位数估计评估协议：

1. 准备流式数据项。在任一系统运行之前，记录配置标识符和输入的顺序。即使测量期间使用随机化的执行顺序，也要在归档中保留原始顺序。

2. 初始化压缩器。如果初始化失败，记录一次初始化失败并停止该次运行。不要将该失败计为查询估计器的一次已完成输出。下一次运行从全新状态开始，并接收其自己的标识符。

3. 测量秩误差。将未成功的输入计入完成率分母。仅在存在对应输出的情况下计算质量统计量，并将该统计量标注为以完成为条件。这两个分母是有意不同的。

4. 在单独的字段中测量内存使用情况。缺失的观测值记录为未知，而不是记录为零。零是一个有效的测量值，如果它同时表示缺失信息，就会使记录产生歧义。

5. 审视这一局限：概率性秩保证并不是对数值之间数值距离的保证。将源输入、观测到的输出以及最小的相关配置附加到失败记录中。解释应说明证据支持什么，以及哪些仍属推测。

验收条件：每个计划中的输入恰好有一条终结记录，所有配置标识符均可恢复，且没有任何缺失观测值被静默替换。满足此条件表明实验被一致地记录。它并不表明被评估的方法在所有可能的输入上都是正确的。原始输入仍保留，供以后重新运行使用。

name: Haiku 5.5 · Messages · adaptive low
source:
The implementation of multi-view scene reconstruction exposes two operations, `prepare_item(x)` and `accept_item(x)`. These names are identifiers, so changing their spelling would change the example. The first operation invokes the camera estimator; the second makes the prepared result visible to the renderer. A successful preparation is necessary but not sufficient for acceptance. The following expression is the complete acceptance condition: `prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`. The expression uses conjunction, not disjunction. If any of its three terms is false, the result is discarded without updating the visible state.

A worker may finish preparation after the user has changed the configuration. Such a worker still carries the old epoch. Its result must be rejected even when the underlying computation succeeded, because it no longer answers the current request. This rejection is a control-flow decision and must not be reported as a numerical failure of the method. By contrast, a result produced under the current epoch can still fail validation if it violates the stated invariant.

The test creates one slow worker and one fast worker. The slow worker starts first, but the fast worker completes first after a configuration change. The visible result must come from the fast worker. The test then releases the slow worker and checks that the visible result remains unchanged. It also checks that `accepted_count` increases exactly once and that `discarded_count` increases exactly once. Neither counter measures the number of input images.
translation:
多视角场景重建的实现暴露了两个操作，`prepare_item(x)` 和 `accept_item(x)`。这些名称是标识符，改动其拼写会改变示例的含义。第一个操作调用相机估计器；第二个操作使已准备好的结果对渲染器可见。成功的准备是接受的必要条件，但并非充分条件。以下表达式是完整的接受条件：`prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`。该表达式使用的是合取，而非析取。若其中三项中有任何一项为假，则丢弃该结果，且不更新可见状态。

工作线程可能在用户更改配置之后才完成准备。此类工作线程仍携带旧的 epoch。即使底层计算已成功，其结果也必须被拒绝，因为它已不再响应当前请求。这种拒绝是控制流决策，不得报告为该方法的数值失败。相反，在当前 epoch 下产生的结果如果违反了所述不变量，仍然可能在验证时失败。

测试创建了一个慢工作线程和一个快工作线程。慢工作线程先启动，但在配置更改后快工作线程先完成。可见结果必须来自快工作线程。随后测试释放慢工作线程，并检查可见结果保持不变。测试还检查 `accepted_count` 恰好增加一次，且 `discarded_count` 恰好增加一次。这两个计数器都不衡量输入图像的数量。

source:
The extracted passage contains line-break artifacts from a two-column paper about multi-view scene reconstruction. In the sentence "The esti-
mator is updated only after vali-
dation," the breaks divide ordinary words. In contrast, the hyphen in "cost-sensitive" is part of the intended compound. The expression `request-id` is an identifier and must retain its spelling. A translator should reconstruct the prose while preserving the distinction between a broken word, a compound, and a code token. None of these examples introduces a new operation into the algorithm.

The camera estimator receives images from an upstream stage. It rejects incomplete records before invoking the renderer. The extracted text "not re-
quired" therefore means that a condition is unnecessary; it must not become an affirmative requirement merely because the line break separates a negation from its complement. We include this example because sentence boundaries inferred from visual lines can be misleading. The source sentence continues after the line break, and its logical subject remains the same.

The passage ends with the statement that a visually smooth surface may still have incorrect depth. This statement limits what can be inferred from an apparently successful output. It does not say that all such outputs are wrong. The evaluation distinguishes a recoverable extraction artifact from genuinely missing source text. When characters are missing rather than merely separated, the result should preserve that uncertainty instead of inventing an unsupported technical detail. The test checks semantic continuity across the repaired lines and exact retention of the identifier, while allowing normal Chinese punctuation and spacing.
translation:
提取的段落包含一篇关于多视角场景重建的双栏论文的换行残留。在句子“The esti-
mator is updated only after vali-
dation”中，换行将普通单词拆开；而“cost-sensitive”中的连字符是原本复合词的一部分。表达式 `request-id` 是标识符，必须保持原拼写。译者应重建文本的语句，同时区分被断开的单词、复合词和代码标记。这些例子都没有在算法中引入新的操作。

相机估计器从上游阶段接收图像。它在调用渲染器之前拒绝不完整的记录。提取文本中的“not re-
quired”因此表示某个条件是不必要的；不能因为换行把否定词与其补足部分分开，就将其变成肯定的要求。我们加入这个例子，是因为依据视觉行推断的句子边界可能会产生误导。原句在换行之后继续，其逻辑主语保持不变。

name: Haiku 5.5 · Messages · adaptive low
source:
We compare two systems for interactive visualization design. The first combines an adaptive selection controller with a fixed view renderer; the second keeps both components fixed. To avoid ambiguity, this section calls them the adaptive system and the fixed system. A third configuration, introduced only in the final ablation, disables the selection controller entirely. It is not the same as the fixed system. All three configurations receive identical visual marks, but only the first two are included in the main comparison. References to "both systems" below therefore exclude the third configuration.

The primary endpoint is task completion time. The secondary endpoint is error rate. These endpoints are reported separately because improving one need not improve the other. We define an improvement relative to the fixed system under the same workload and measurement procedure. A result obtained under a different workload is described as a separate experiment, even if its numerical value happens to be better. The primary table contains five independently initialized runs for each system. Repeated observations within a run are used to estimate that run's endpoint; they are not counted as additional independent runs.

The development workload contains first-time participants, whereas the stress workload includes experienced participants. The stress workload is constructed before inspecting the final outputs. It remains unchanged throughout the comparison. Neither system may use the stress outputs to select a checkpoint or adjust a threshold. When the adaptive system updates its internal state during inference, those updates are part of the evaluated method. They do not authorize an experimenter to alter the externally specified threshold after seeing a failure. This distinction matters because otherwise adaptation and retrospective tuning would be indistinguishable.

At the start of each run, both systems have empty application caches. The selection controller may nevertheless reuse immutable preprocessing shared by all configurations. We measure this preprocessing separately and disclose it in the report. The first timed request begins only after preprocessing has finished. A second table includes the preprocessing cost, allowing readers to assess a one-shot use case. These two tables answer different questions. Their numbers must not be added together, because the second already includes the work described by the first. A cache hit inside the timed region is recorded explicitly.

The adaptive system performs better on the development workload in four of the five runs. In the remaining run, the difference is smaller than the measurement resolution. This observation does not establish that the adaptive system is universally superior. On the stress workload, it fails on two inputs that the fixed system handles successfully. Conversely, the fixed system fails on three inputs that the adaptive system handles successfully. We retain every failure in the denominator when reporting completion rates. Quality among completed outputs is also reported, but it is labeled as a conditional statistic.

Inspection of the failed cases suggests an important limitation: a participant may finish quickly while misunderstanding the represented uncertainty. The inspection identifies a plausible mechanism, not a proven causal explanation. To test that mechanism, a follow-up experiment would need to vary the suspected factor while holding other factors constant. The present comparison does not do that. Its evidence supports a narrower statement: the observed failures are consistent with the proposed mechanism. Translating this statement as a demonstration of causality would materially strengthen the claim beyond the evidence supplied by the experiment.

Finally, the ablation without the selection controller is evaluated on a small diagnostic subset. It helps determine whether that component contributes to the observed behavior, but it is not used to replace either main system in the headline comparison. The diagnostic subset is deliberately enriched for difficult cases and does not estimate their frequency in ordinary use. We therefore publish its results separately. The released configuration, dataset identifiers, and individual run records make the comparison reproducible; they do not guarantee that a different machine or workload will reproduce the same absolute timings.
translation:
我们比较了两个用于交互式可视化设计的系统。第一个系统将自适应选择控制器与固定视图渲染器结合在一起；第二个系统则将两个组件都保持固定。为避免歧义，本节将它们称为自适应系统和固定系统。第三种配置仅在最终的消融实验中引入，它完全禁用选择控制器。该配置与固定系统并不相同。三种配置接收的视觉标记完全相同，但只有前两种被纳入主要比较。因此，下文中提到的"两个系统"不包括第三种配置。

主要终点是任务完成时间，次要终点是错误率。之所以分别报告这两个终点，是因为改进其中一个未必会改进另一个。我们在相同的工作负载和测量程序下，相对于固定系统定义改进。在不同工作负载下得到的结果，即使其数值恰好更好，也应被描述为一个单独的实验。主表为每个系统包含五次独立初始化的运行。每次运行内的重复观测仅用于估计该次运行的终点，不计为额外的独立运行。

开发工作负载包含初次参与的被试，而压力工作负载则包含有经验的被试。压力工作负载是在检查最终输出之前构建的，并且在整个比较过程中保持不变。两个系统都不得使用压力测试的输出来选择检查点或调整阈值。当自适应系统在推理过程中更新其内部状态时，这些更新属于被评估方法的一部分。它们并不授权实验者在看到失败后更改外部指定的阈值。这一区分很重要，否则自适应与事后调参将无法区分。

每次运行开始时，两个系统的应用缓存均为空。选择控制器仍可复用所有配置共享的、不可变的预处理结果。我们单独测量该预处理并在报告中披露。第一个计时请求仅在预处理完成后开始。第二张表包含预处理成本，便于读者评估一次性使用场景。这两张表回答的是不同的问题，其数字不得相加，因为第二张表已经包含了第一张表所描述的工作。计时区域内的缓存命中会被明确记录。

在开发工作负载上，自适应系统在五次运行中有四次表现更好。在其余一次运行中，差异小于测量分辨率。这一观察并不能证明自适应系统普遍更优。在压力工作负载上，自适应系统在固定系统能成功处理的两个输入上失败；反之，固定系统在自适应系统能成功处理的三个输入上失败。在报告完成率时，我们将所有失败案例保留在分母中。已完成输出中的质量也会报告，但将其标注为条件统计量。

对失败案例的检查揭示了一个重要局限：被试可能很快完成任务，却误解了所呈现的不确定性。该检查识别出一种合理的机制，但并非经过证实的因果解释。要检验该机制，后续实验需要在保持其他因素不变的情况下改变被怀疑的因素。本次比较并未这样做。其证据只支持一个较窄的结论：所观察到的失败与所提出的机制相一致。若将这一结论表述为因果关系的证明，则会使论断超出实验所提供证据的范围，从而实质性地加强结论。

最后，不含选择控制器的消融实验是在一个小型诊断子集上评估的。它有助于判断该组件是否对所观察到的行为有贡献，但并不用于取代头条比较中的任何一个主系统。该诊断子集是有意富集困难案例的，不能用于估计这些案例在日常使用中的出现频率。因此，我们单独发布其结果。已发布的配置、数据集标识符以及各次运行的记录使该比较可以复现；但它们并不保证在不同的机器或工作负载上能复现相同的绝对计时结果。

name: Haiku 5.5 · Messages · adaptive low
source:
Protocol for evaluating streaming quantile estimation:

1. Prepare the stream items. Record the configuration identifier and the order of the inputs before either system runs. Retain the original ordering in the archive, even when a randomized execution order is used during measurement.

2. Initialize the compactor. If initialization fails, record an initialization failure and stop that run. Do not count the failure as a completed output from the query estimator. The next run starts from a fresh state and receives its own identifier.

3. Measure rank error. Include unsuccessful inputs in the completion-rate denominator. Compute the quality statistic only where a corresponding output exists, and label that statistic as conditional on completion. These two denominators are intentionally different.

4. Measure memory usage in a separate field. A missing observation is recorded as unknown, rather than as zero. Zero is a valid measured value and cannot also stand for missing information without making the record ambiguous.

5. Inspect the limitation that a probabilistic rank guarantee is not a guarantee on the numerical distance between values. Attach the source input, the observed output, and the smallest relevant configuration to the failure record. The explanation should identify what the evidence supports and what remains speculative.

Acceptance condition: every scheduled input has exactly one terminal record, all configuration identifiers are recoverable, and no missing observation is silently replaced. Passing this condition establishes that the experiment was recorded consistently. It does not establish that the evaluated method is correct on every possible input. The original inputs remain available for a later rerun.
translation:
流式分位数估计评估协议：

1. 准备流式输入项。在任一系统运行之前，记录配置标识符和输入的顺序。即使在测量时使用了随机化的执行顺序，也要在存档中保留原始顺序。

2. 初始化压缩器（compactor）。若初始化失败，记录一次初始化失败并终止该次运行。不要将该失败计为查询估计器的一次已完成输出。下一次运行从全新状态开始，并获得其自身的标识符。

3. 测量秩误差。未成功的输入应计入完成率的分母。仅对存在对应输出的情形计算质量统计量，并将该统计量标注为“以完成为条件”。这两个分母是有意设置为不同的。

4. 在单独的字段中测量内存占用。缺失的观测值应记录为“未知”，而不是记为零。零是一个有效的测量值，若同时用它表示缺失信息，记录将变得含糊不清。

验收条件：每个已排定的输入恰好有一条终态记录，所有配置标识符均可恢复，且没有任何缺失观测值被悄悄替换。满足此条件仅说明实验已被一致地记录，并不能证明所评估的方法在所有可能的输入上都是正确的。原始输入仍可用于之后的重新运行。

source:
The implementation of multi-view scene reconstruction exposes two operations, `prepare_item(x)` and `accept_item(x)`. These names are identifiers, so changing their spelling would change the example. The first operation invokes the camera estimator; the second makes the prepared result visible to the renderer. A successful preparation is necessary but not sufficient for acceptance. The following expression is the complete acceptance condition: `prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`. The expression uses conjunction, not disjunction. If any of its three terms is false, the result is discarded without updating the visible state.

A worker may finish preparation after the user has changed the configuration. Such a worker still carries the old epoch. Its result must be rejected even when the underlying computation succeeded, because it no longer answers the current request. This rejection is a control-flow decision and must not be reported as a numerical failure of the method. By contrast, a result produced under the current epoch can still fail validation if it violates the stated invariant.

The test creates one slow worker and one fast worker. The slow worker starts first, but the fast worker completes first after a configuration change. The visible result must come from the fast worker. The test then releases the slow worker and checks that the visible result remains unchanged. It also checks that `accepted_count` increases exactly once and that `discarded_count` increases exactly once. Neither counter measures the number of input images.
translation:
多视角场景重建的实现暴露了两个操作，即 `prepare_item(x)` 和 `accept_item(x)`。这些名称都是标识符，改动拼写会改变示例本身。第一个操作调用相机估计器；第二个操作使已准备好的结果对渲染器可见。准备成功是接受的必要条件，但不是充分条件。下列表达式是完整的接受条件：`prepared && valid && epoch == current_epoch`。该表达式使用的是合取（与），而不是析取（或）。如果其中任一项为假，结果将被丢弃，且可见状态不会更新。

用户更改配置后，工作线程仍可能完成准备工作。此类工作线程仍携带旧的 epoch。即使底层计算成功，其结果也必须被拒绝，因为它已不再回应当前请求。这种拒绝属于控制流决策，不得报告为方法的数值失败。相反，在当前 epoch 下产生的结果，如果违反了既定不变式，仍然可能在验证阶段失败。

该测试创建一个慢速工作线程和一个快速工作线程。慢速工作线程先启动，但在配置更改后，快速工作线程先完成。可见结果必须来自快速工作线程。随后测试释放慢速工作线程，并检查可见结果保持不变。测试还检查 `accepted_count` 恰好增加一次、`discarded_count` 恰好增加一次。这两个计数器都不衡量输入图像的数量。

The camera estimator receives images from an upstream stage. It rejects incomplete records before invoking the renderer. The extracted text "not re-

It does not say that all such outputs are wrong. The evaluation distinguishes a recoverable extraction artifact from genuinely missing source text. When characters are missing rather than merely separated, the result should preserve that uncertainty instead of inventing an unsupported technical detail. name: Haiku 5.5 · Messages · 关闭
source:
We compare two systems for interactive visualization design. The first combines an adaptive selection controller with a fixed view renderer; the second keeps both components fixed. To avoid ambiguity, this section calls them the adaptive system and the fixed system. A third configuration, introduced only in the final ablation, disables the selection controller entirely. It is not the same as the fixed system. All three configurations receive identical visual marks, but only the first two are included in the main comparison. References to "both systems" below therefore exclude the third configuration.

The primary endpoint is task completion time. The secondary endpoint is error rate. These endpoints are reported separately because improving one need not improve the other. We define an improvement relative to the fixed system under the same workload and measurement procedure. A result obtained under a different workload is described as a separate experiment, even if its numerical value happens to be better. The primary table contains five independently initialized runs for each system. Repeated observations within a run are used to estimate that run's endpoint; they are not counted as additional independent runs.

The development workload contains first-time participants, whereas the stress workload includes experienced participants. The stress workload is constructed before inspecting the final outputs. It remains unchanged throughout the comparison. Neither system may use the stress outputs to select a checkpoint or adjust a threshold. When the adaptive system updates its internal state during inference, those updates are part of the evaluated method. They do not authorize an experimenter to alter the externally specified threshold after seeing a failure. This distinction matters because otherwise adaptation and retrospective tuning would be indistinguishable.

At the start of each run, both systems have empty application caches. The selection controller may nevertheless reuse immutable preprocessing shared by all configurations. We measure this preprocessing separately and disclose it in the report. The first timed request begins only after preprocessing has finished. A second table includes the preprocessing cost, allowing readers to assess a one-shot use case. These two tables answer different questions. Their numbers must not be added together, because the second already includes the work described by the first. A cache hit inside the timed region is recorded explicitly.

The adaptive system performs better on the development workload in four of the five runs. In the remaining run, the difference is smaller than the measurement resolution. This observation does not establish that the adaptive system is universally superior. On the stress workload, it fails on two inputs that the fixed system handles successfully. Conversely, the fixed system fails on three inputs that the adaptive system handles successfully. We retain every failure in the denominator when reporting completion rates. Quality among completed outputs is also reported, but it is labeled as a conditional statistic.

Inspection of the failed cases suggests an important limitation: a participant may finish quickly while misunderstanding the represented uncertainty. The inspection identifies a plausible mechanism, not a proven causal explanation. To test that mechanism, a follow-up experiment would need to vary the suspected factor while holding other factors constant. The present comparison does not do that. Its evidence supports a narrower statement: the observed failures are consistent with the proposed mechanism. Translating this statement as a demonstration of causality would materially strengthen the claim beyond the evidence supplied by the experiment.

Finally, the ablation without the selection controller is evaluated on a small diagnostic subset. It helps determine whether that component contributes to the observed behavior, but it is not used to replace either main system in the headline comparison. The diagnostic subset is deliberately enriched for difficult cases and does not estimate their frequency in ordinary use. We therefore publish its results separately. The released configuration, dataset identifiers, and individual run records make the comparison reproducible; they do not guarantee that a different machine or workload will reproduce the same absolute timings.
translation:
我们比较了两种用于交互式可视化设计的系统。第一种将自适应选择控制器与固定的视图渲染器相结合；第二种则两个组件都保持固定。为避免歧义，本节将它们分别称为自适应系统和固定系统。第三种配置仅在最终的消融实验中引入，它完全禁用选择控制器。它与固定系统并不相同。三种配置接收的视觉标记完全相同，但只有前两种被纳入主要比较。因此，下文提到的"两种系统"不包括第三种配置。

主要终点是任务完成时间，次要终点是错误率。这两个终点分开报告，因为改进其中一个未必会改进另一个。我们在相同的工作负载和测量流程下，相对于固定系统来定义改进。在不同工作负载下获得的结果被描述为单独的实验，即使其数值恰好更优。主表中每种系统包含五次独立初始化的运行。同一运行内的重复观测用于估计该运行的终点指标，不计为额外的独立运行。

开发工作负载包含首次参与的受试者，而压力测试工作负载包含有经验的受试者。压力测试工作负载是在检查最终输出之前构建的，并在整个比较过程中保持不变。两种系统均不得使用压力测试的输出来选择检查点或调整阈值。当自适应系统在推理期间更新其内部状态时，这些更新属于被评估方法的一部分。它们并不授权实验者在看到失败案例后修改外部指定的阈值。这一区分很重要，否则自适应与事后调参将无法区分。

每次运行开始时，两种系统的应用缓存均为空。不过，选择控制器可以复用所有配置共享的不可变预处理步骤。我们单独测量这一预处理过程并在报告中披露。第一个计时请求仅在预处理完成后开始。第二张表包含预处理成本，使读者能够评估一次性使用的场景。这两张表回答的是不同的问题，其数字不得相加，因为第二张表已包含第一张表所描述的工作。计时区域内发生的缓存命中会被明确记录。

在五次运行中的四次，自适应系统在开发工作负载上表现更好。在其余一次运行中，差异小于测量分辨率。这一观察并不能证明自适应系统普遍更优。在压力测试工作负载上，它在两个固定系统能成功处理的输入上失败；反之，固定系统在三个自适应系统能成功处理的输入上失败。报告完成率时，我们将所有失败案例都保留在分母中。已完成输出的质量也有报告，但它被标注为条件统计量。

对失败案例的检查提示了一个重要局限：受试者可能很快完成任务，却误解了所呈现的不确定性。该检查指出了一种合理的机制，但并非已被证实的因果解释。要检验这一机制，后续实验需要在保持其他因素不变的同时改变所怀疑的因素。本次比较并未这样做。其证据只支持一个更为有限的结论：所观察到的失败与所提出的机制相符。若将这一结论表述为因果关系的证明，则会使主张超出实验所提供的证据范围。

最后，不含选择控制器的消融实验是在一个小型诊断子集上评估的。它有助于判断该组件是否促成了所观察到的行为，但并未用于替换主比较中的任何一种系统。该诊断子集有意偏向困难案例，并不能估计这些案例在日常使用中的出现频率。因此，我们单独公布其结果。所发布的配置、数据集标识符和各次运行的记录使比较具有可复现性；但这并不保证在不同的机器或工作负载上能复现相同的绝对计时结果。

name: Haiku 5.5 · Messages · 关闭
source:
Protocol for evaluating streaming quantile estimation:

1. Prepare the stream items. Record the configuration identifier and the order of the inputs before either system runs. Retain the original ordering in the archive, even when a randomized execution order is used during measurement.

2. Initialize the compactor. If initialization fails, record an initialization failure and stop that run. Do not count the failure as a completed output from the query estimator. The next run starts from a fresh state and receives its own identifier.

3. Measure rank error. Include unsuccessful inputs in the completion-rate denominator. Compute the quality statistic only where a corresponding output exists, and label that statistic as conditional on completion. These two denominators are intentionally different.

4. Measure memory usage in a separate field. A missing observation is recorded as unknown, rather than as zero. Zero is a valid measured value and cannot also stand for missing information without making the record ambiguous.

5. Inspect the limitation that a probabilistic rank guarantee is not a guarantee on the numerical distance between values. Attach the source input, the observed output, and the smallest relevant configuration to the failure record. The explanation should identify what the evidence supports and what remains speculative.

Acceptance condition: every scheduled input has exactly one terminal record, all configuration identifiers are recoverable, and no missing observation is silently replaced. Passing this condition establishes that the experiment was recorded consistently. It does not establish that the evaluated method is correct on every possible input. The original inputs remain available for a later rerun.
translation:
用于评估流式分位数估计的协议：

1. 准备流数据项。在任一系统运行之前，记录配置标识符和输入的顺序。即使在测量时使用了随机化的执行顺序，也应在存档中保留原始顺序。

2. 初始化压缩器（compactor）。若初始化失败，则记录一次初始化失败并停止该次运行。不要将该失败计为查询估计器的一次已完成输出。下一次运行从全新状态开始，并获得其自身的标识符。

3. 测量秩误差。在完成率的分母中包含未成功的输入。仅在存在对应输出的情况下计算质量统计量，并将该统计量标注为以完成为条件。这两个分母有意地不同。

4. 在单独的字段中测量内存使用情况。缺失的观测值应记录为“未知”，而不是零。零是一个有效的测量值，若同时用它表示缺失信息，会使记录产生歧义。

5. 检查以下局限性：概率性的秩保证并不是对数值之间距离的保证。请将源输入、观察到的输出以及最小的相关配置附加到失败记录中。解释应指明证据支持什么，以及哪些内容仍属推测。

验收条件：每个已排定的输入恰好有一条终结记录，所有配置标识符均可恢复，且没有任何缺失观测值被静默替换。满足此条件仅说明实验记录是一致的，并不说明所评估的方法在所有可能的输入上都是正确的。原始输入仍保留，以供日后重新运行。
